inputs.name: signals
inputs.constraints: Three f64 signals: condition_number_log10, metadata_incompatibility_score, anomaly_score. Clamped to [0,1] internally (condition scaled by /16).

outputs.name: decision
outputs.semantics: Contains action (Allow/FullValidate/FailClosed), top risk state, posterior probabilities, expected losses, and human-readable reason.

contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Uses Hardened loss matrix: [[0.0, 50.0, 180.0], [5.0, 3.0, 60.0], [55.0, 30.0, 1.0]]. Higher FailClosed+Compatible cost makes Hardened slightly less eager to reject good inputs.

inputs.name: condition
inputs.constraints: One of: WellConditioned, ModerateCondition, IllConditioned, NearSingular.

outputs.name: action
outputs.semantics: Selected solver: DirectLU, PivotedQR, SVDFallback, DiagonalFastPath, or TriangularFastPath.

outputs.name: posterior
outputs.semantics: Posterior probability distribution over condition states.

outputs.name: losses
outputs.semantics: Expected loss for each candidate action.

outputs.name: chosen_loss
outputs.semantics: Expected loss of the selected action.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Standard 5x4 loss matrix: DirectLU cheapest for WellConditioned, PivotedQR for Moderate, SVD for Ill/NearSingular.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same loss matrix and selection logic; mode only affects evidence recording.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.type_desc: sequence of f64 backward errors via observe()
inputs.constraints: At least 10 observations required before fallback can trigger. Violation threshold = 1e-8.

outputs.name: should_fallback
outputs.semantics: True when empirical miscoverage rate exceeds alpha + epsilon (0.05 + 0.02 = 0.07 by default).

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Advisory fallback signal; caller decides whether to force SVD.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same advisory signal; enforcement is at SolverPortfolio level.
